prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1476; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client was injured in this incident and is entitled to pursue full compensation for medical expenses, lost income, and pain and suffering. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide written confirmation of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy that applies to the at-fault driver, along with a copy of the declarations page. We also request that your insurer preserve all evidence relating to this loss, including the claim file, photographs, recorded statements, vehicle data, repair estimates, and any dashcam or telematics information. Please treat this as formal notice to preserve all such materials. We look forward to your prompt response.
